intro.heading: We offer a range of services that help clients plan better, manage efficiently, and build with confidence.
intro.text: At Uniprix Investment, we offer end-to-end solutions that support clients from the earliest planning stages through construction, interior design, and project completion. Our services are designed to ensure clarity, quality, and confidence at every stage.

cards.title: Architectural & Structural Design
cards.description: We create detailed architectural plans and structural designs tailored to your vision, site conditions, and budget — ensuring safety, functionality, and aesthetic appeal.

cards.title: Construction & Project Management
cards.description: From groundbreaking to handover, we manage every aspect of the build — coordinating contractors, materials, timelines, and quality control so your project is delivered on time and on budget.

cards.title: Interior Design & Finishing
cards.description: Our interior design team transforms spaces into functional, beautiful environments — selecting materials, finishes, furniture, and lighting that reflect your style and purpose.

cards.title: Renovation & Remodelling
cards.description: We breathe new life into existing structures — from residential upgrades to full commercial overhauls — with minimal disruption and maximum impact.

cards.title: Real Estate Consultation
cards.description: We guide investors and homeowners through Uganda's real estate landscape — from site identification and valuation to market analysis and investment strategy.

cta.heading: Planning to build, renovate, or invest?
cta.text: Let's guide your project from idea to completion with professionalism and care.
